verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, a physical hardware component, so serving tools to agents through an official MCP server is outside its product category. Buyers comparing CPUs would not reasonably ask this. Nothing in the evidence (marketing pages, oneAPI/OpenVINO docs, an llms.txt probe, failed OpenAPI probes) shows an MCP server tied to the chip, so the axis does not apply.
